reading.a: An evening crowd of about twenty people stands behind a chain-link fence in front of a white brick wall carrying an air-conditioner, two large wooden cart wheels, a Ukrainian flag and a painted green-hills mural.
reading.b: A daytime lounge under a hanging-stick ceiling (element 1): eight shirtless men on green sofas in front, two paintings on a dark wall at the left, and a glass wall at the right looking onto pine trunks, a building and green foliage.

concepts.idea: The camera pulls back out of the bar crowd until it stands outside the lounge's glass wall, with B's ceiling, dark wall and seated men entering over it as in round 10, each man now in front of the pane as himself; once the pane reads as a pane (t 0.3), the brick wall, wheels and flag above the crowd become pines, foliage and sky while the crowd and the fence stay (reached at t 0.55), then the crowd slowly dissolves into the forest and B's view below the trees (t 0.55-0.92), and the last of A in the glass gives way brightest-first (t 0.92-1.0).

anchors.how: Unchanged from rounds 8-10: A's whole frame goes onto the quad in the glass wall's plane, every edge of A behind a B occluder (he named the precision of this placement).

transforms.name: pane_becomes_view
transforms.note: The one beat, the same keyframe he liked ('intermediate generated r10_m3_pane.png looks nice'). Answers 'crossfaded into forest in window pane during single frame ( too fast, was expecting people from A to dissolve into forest)': the chain now runs linear in its window with a linear mix per segment (round-11 rule, ease written out), the window ends at 0.92 instead of 0.85 and the keyframe is reached at chain progress 0.4 instead of 0.55. Segments in clip time (a clip of about 3.0 s): A to the pane keyframe, the wall becoming trees, clip t 0.30-0.55, about 0.75 s; the pane keyframe to B, the crowd dissolving into the forest, clip t 0.55-0.92, about 1.1 s (round 10 showed this dissolve in about 0.24 s). Round 12: the round-11 plan of the accepted clip ('i would tentatively accept this result') with the motion and reveal keys added; the one other change is that params.ease 'linear' is no longer written, because the renderer reads a written ease before the motion model's trapezoid (director_render.py line 876) and the page is meant to show what the motion model changes. Under the trapezoid (edge 0.35) the keyframe is reached at about t 0.57 instead of 0.55. The chain's b is null, so the guard has no target here.

helper.what: One generated picture of the view through the pane in A's frame: the upper half (brick wall, wheels, flag, air-conditioner) replaced by B's pines, building and sky; A's crowd and fence kept person for person, with two small changes (one V sign became a closed hand, one woman gained sunglasses); everything outside the pane and both end frames stay original.

knobs.name: front_per_element
knobs.what: B's front as one layer per element in depth order, each with its own matte and depth move; it answers 'frame B during movement still overlapped several foreground people'; false restores round 10's single front layer for comparison.

knobs.name: pane_becomes_view.params.times[0]
knobs.what: When the pane keyframe is reached in the chain; lower gives the crowd's dissolve into the forest more of the 0.62-clip-fraction window, higher gives the wall-to-trees change more.

knobs.name: pane_becomes_view.window[1]
knobs.what: When the chain reaches B inside the pane; later lengthens the crowd's dissolve but leaves less time before the last frame.

concepts.risk: F1 double exposure: the crowd → forest segment is still a flow-guided dissolve (the keyframe keeps the crowd, B has none), now 1.1 s long and linear, so watch t 0.6-0.85 for half-strength people over the pines and sofas for many frames; that is the dissolve he asked for, but if the flow drags faces into tree trunks it reads as smear, not dissolve. The end effect over [0.92, 1.0] starts when the chain reaches B; if what remains of A in the glass (the reflection blend) is large, its 0.24 s brightest-first clearing can read as a second, fast step after the slow dissolve (the 'single frame' fault in another place). F2 decoration: with one front layer per element, two adjoining men each move by their own depth; a gap of the pane may open between them at t 0.2-0.5 (check the front layers against his round-10 frame). F3 invention: the keyframe's closed hand and sunglasses are in the crowd during t 0.4-0.8; the page must say the keyframe is generated.
